native.architecture: Unmodified LeRobot ACT defaults: 640x480, dim_model 512, feedforward 3200, encoder 4, chunk 100

refit.selection: Choose supplementary-data family/regime using validation means only; fixed-duration refit on all 15 recordings; no independent final test remains.

simulation_policy: Do not publish policy task success until recorded-success replay and physical calibration gates pass.
interpretation: Four supplementary recording folds; each holds out one for validation and one for evaluation, trains on the remaining two. This is exploratory cross-validation on already inspected collected data, not a newly collected independent test.
